messages.author: 220b7523636392b1
messages.subject: axis tick increments
parts:
Hi all,

For cases where only whole numbers make sense, how would you force
ggplot to only show integer values (avoid decimal increments) on the
axes? This is specifically w.r.t. facets. Thanks for any pointers.

Prasad

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: axis tick increments
parts:
In the appropriate scale_x or scale_y, look at the 'breaks' argument.
Without any further elaboration on your end, there's no way to provide
more detail on this end.

Dennis

messages.author: 220b7523636392b1
messages.subject: Re: axis tick increments
parts:
Thank you for the tip. That worked for me after specifying
breaks=0:100, although for cases where the data ranges for facets vary
widely, say 0:2 for one and 0:100 another, this puts a xtick every 1
and the latter looks bad. With the defaults, the latter looks fine but
the first chart shows 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, where I don't want the
decimals. I'm set for now but wonder if there are other things one
could play with to control axis tick increments.

Prasad
